data.name: Enamul
data.gender_notes: Enamul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Enamul is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'enam' meaning 'jewel' and 'deva' meaning 'gods'. This name signifies being the precious gift of the gods. The name Enamul carries the meaning “Jewel of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Enamul usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Enamul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Enamul total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, the name 'Enamul' holds immense spiritual significance. The name is a reminder of the child's divine origins and serves as a constant reminder of their connection to the gods. It is believed that the name bestows upon the child blessings and grace from the divine realm, ensuring their growth and prosperity in life. Also, it is considered to be an auspicious name for a child, and parents hope that the child will live up to the name and bring joy, success, and happiness to their family.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Enamul derives from the Sanskrit words 'Anena' (with love) and 'Mam' (me). It symbolizes one who is deeply loved and cherished, embodying the essence of selfless love and devotion.
